slides.narration: Chapter 21: The Strong CP Problem. Why doesn't the strong force violate the symmetry between matter and antimatter? Standard physics has no answer. The tower has one: the theta parameter is zero because the tower's structure forbids it.

In the Standard Model, a parameter called theta could make the strong force treat matter and antimatter differently. Experiments show theta is essentially zero — but no one knows why. In the framework, theta is zero because the tower's palindromic structure forces exact symmetry. No fine-tuning needed.
